name: Facility Apes 3 Vr
summary: Facility Apes 3 is a Backrooms style VR horror adventure with over 36 unique Levels to explore, escape, and survive. Each Level introduces new layouts, puzzles, entities, and challenges that keep the experience unpredictable every time you play. Go in alone or team up with up to six players for a chaotic co-op run where teamwork, panic, and pure improvisation decide whether you make it out… or get lost even deeper...
